candidates.title: Missing Role-Based Authorization in Products Controller
candidates.claim: The ProductsController lacks any authorization checks (e.g., `authorize!` or `before_action` with `can`/`should`), allowing any authenticated user to potentially perform CRUD operations on products regardless of their role (superadmin, admin, manager, operator).
candidates.evidence: The file `/app/app/controllers/products_controller.rb` contains only `class ProductsController < ApplicationController` with no `before_action` filters, `authorize!` calls, or role-based guards. The User model defines roles, but no controller enforces them.
candidates.proposed_verification: Run `rails console` and attempt to call `ProductsController.new.create` or `ProductsController.new.destroy` with a user having limited roles (e.g., 'operator') to verify if the action succeeds without permission checks.
